params.q: is Wolf River Electric being sued

textBlocks.snippet: No, Wolf River Electric is not the one being sued.

The confusion stems from a prominent error made by Google's "AI Overview" feature, which falsely claimed that the Isanti, Minnesota-based solar installation company was facing a lawsuit from the Minnesota Attorney General. While the Minnesota Attorney General did file a lawsuit against several separate solar-lending companies regarding hidden fees, Wolf River Electric was never a defendant in that case.

Instead, Wolf River Electric is the plaintiff. The company filed a defamation lawsuit against Google, seeking massive damages after the AI's incorrect summary led to canceled customer contracts and business losses.

No, Wolf River Electric is not the one being sued.

The confusion stems from a prominent error made by Google's "AI Overview" feature, which falsely claimed that the Isanti, Minnesota\-based solar installation company was facing a lawsuit from the Minnesota Attorney General. While the Minnesota Attorney General did file a lawsuit against several separate solar\-lending companies regarding hidden fees, Wolf River Electric was never a defendant in that case.

Instead, Wolf River Electric is the plaintiff. The company filed a defamation lawsuit against Google, seeking massive damages after the AI's incorrect summary led to canceled customer contracts and business losses.
